_README: Copy this file to authors.json and fill it in. Nothing here is a real name.
Then re-run, from own-article/paper/en:
python assemble_paper_en.py && python verify_paper_en.py
python make_docx.py && python format_mdpi_docx.py
python ../../../.codex-tmp/mdpi-format/audit_mdpi.py
The audit prints every [[...]] placeholder still in the file; with this file
filled in and a DOI in data_location, it should print none.
MDPI does not require a particular number of authors: one is a valid paper.
Every author needs a name, initials, an affiliation, an e-mail and (MDPI
displays them, and requires one for the corresponding author) an ORCID iD.
Exactly one author carries "corresponding": true.
"affiliation" is the 1-based index into the affiliations list; add one entry
per distinct institution and give every affiliation at least one author.
"initials" is what the CRediT sentence uses, e.g. A.B. for Anna Behrens.
author_contributions must name every author in at least one CRediT role and
end with MDPI's sentence about the published version.
funding: name every funder with grant numbers, or exactly
'This research received no external funding.'
data_location: the public, citable home of own-article/regen/results -- a
repository URL and an archived release with a DOI. MDPI requires a link or
an explicit statement of restriction; a private path is not sufficient.
affiliations: Department, Institution, Street, Postcode, City, Country
Second Department, Second Institution, Street, Postcode, City, Country
author_contributions: Conceptualization, G.F. and S.A.; methodology, G.F.; software, G.F.; validation, G.F. and S.A.; formal analysis, G.F.; investigation, G.F.; resources, S.A.; data curation, G.F.; writing---original draft preparation, G.F.; writing---review and editing, G.F. and S.A.; visualization, G.F.; supervision, S.A.; project administration, S.A.; funding acquisition, S.A. All authors have read and agreed to the published version of the manuscript.
funding: This research received no external funding.
conflicts_of_interest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
data_location: The regeneration tree, the analysis scripts and the derived tables are archived at [ARCHIVE NAME], https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX (accessed on DD Month YYYY).
